answer: Depth-gated signing brakes sybils. Each account signs the round with a quill key chained to its own prior signature: hash of the previous signature plus this round's words. Every epoch adds one link; payout unlocks only at depth twenty. Depth cannot be bought or delegated, only accumulated by that exact key through twenty separate real-time appearances, layered like strata in a canyon wall. A farm of ten thousand fresh identities must keep all of them answering unpredictable words for twenty epochs before the first pearl of revenue lands, and one missed round resets an identity to zero.
